title: Biochemical Measures of Neuropathy - Hydrogen Peroxide Assay
author: Eva Feldman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7rghm3w
materials: Prepare stock solutions above for Amplex Red Reagent, Reaction Buffer, HRP, 20 mM H ² O ² and Resorufin, sodium salt.

steps.title: Prepare H2O2 standard curve
steps.instruction: Label tubes 1‑5. Add 999 µL 1X Reaction Buffer to tube 2, then add 100 µL 1X Reaction Buffer to tubes 2‑5. Add 1 µL of 20 mM H₂O₂ working dilution to tube 1 to obtain 20 µM. Perform serial 1:1 dilutions: transfer 100 µL from tube 1 to tube 2, 100 µL from tube 2 to tube 3, and 100 µL from tube 3 to tube 4. Tube 5 receives only dH₂O. Final concentrations range from 20 µM down to 0‑10 µM (two‑fold lower each step).

steps.title: Dilute samples in buffer
steps.instruction: Dilute each experimental sample in 1X Reaction Buffer to the same volume used for standards.

steps.title: Prepare Amplex Red/HRP solution
steps.instruction: From a 20 µM Amplex Red stock, prepare a 400 µM working solution containing 2 U/mL HRP by mixing 20 µL Amplex Red stock, 100 µL 200 U/mL HRP stock, and 9.7 mL 1X Reaction Buffer.

steps.title: Dispense standards and samples
steps.instruction: Pipette 100 µL of each diluted standard, any controls, and each diluted sample into individual wells of a microplate. (For DRG tissue, 25 µL per well was used.)

steps.title: Add detection reagent
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of the prepared 400 µM Amplex Red/HRP mixture to each well to initiate the reaction.

steps.title: Start fluorescence measurement
steps.instruction: Place the plate into the Fluoroskan holder and click START.

steps.title: Collect kinetic readings
steps.instruction: Take four fluorescence readings at 15‑minute intervals using the 544 nm excitation / 590 nm emission filter pair.

steps.title: Save raw data file
steps.instruction: Save the raw data as an Excel file in the RHPx data folder using the naming convention RHXXXX.xls, where XXXX is the date in mmdd format.

steps.title: Organize data in software
steps.instruction: In the analysis program, select Process > Organize, choose the appropriate dataset (usually Measure1), click OK to rearrange the data into columns.

steps.title: Save organized data file
steps.instruction: Save the organized data as an Excel file in the RHP data folder using the naming convention rhXXXXor.xls, where XXXX is the date in mmdd format.
